correctness.rationale: The support-functional reduction is exact in real smooth two-dimensional \(\ell_p\). The reverse D-threshold is exact because the annihilator of \(x\) is one-dimensional. For \(p=3\) and \(p=3/2\) the same scalar objective \(F(w)\) results; its derivative has a unique interior maximizer and the endpoints are explicitly checked. Equality is realized by a coordinate ratio solving \(\sqrt{u(1-u)}=(\sqrt7-1)/6\). Numerical replay only checks algebra and does not replace the analytic global argument. Therefore the reviewed final value is \(\varepsilon_D(\ell_3^2)=\varepsilon_D(\ell_{3/2}^2)=\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{27}{17+7\sqrt7}\right)^{2/3}}\).
